evidence.explanation: The sequenced Mth952-Mth961 interval does not make every gene in it causal. Named A/B substitutions and differential protein expression cannot be transferred to PF01629. Publisher full text was unavailable.
Q58031/MJ0614 from M. jannaschii JAL-1, taxon 243232, sequence version 1, 130 residues, maps to PF01629 at 7-110. Matching UniProt/InterPro reference sequences establish identity, not function.
The primary 2003 ATPase purification paper is a follow-up lead. Its PDF was not retrieved; no full-text or experiment-specific assessment is claimed.

discussions.notes: Bounded searches covered DUF22/PF01629/COG1417 and MJ0614/Q58031/MTH952/MTH0952/MMP1047. No causal edge is supported by the inspected material; this is not an exhaustive absence claim. Resolve plant DUF221/OSCA alias collisions before transferring any calcium-channel claim. Minimal identity and excluded-transfer evidence is retained under evidence/PF01629; no dummy graph is added.
discussions.prompt: Obtain a verified DUF22 member-specific perturbation or biochemical assay before adding a causal graph.
discussions.rationale: The inspected evidence grounds MJ0614 in PF01629 but does not establish a directed biological effect. ATPase gene proximity and dUTPase-clan membership are not functional experiments. The inspected tributyltin study's abstract assigns mutations to ATP synthase A/B subunits, not to an isolated DUF22 intervention.
